page_title: BAY 3-0 WER | Bayern Munich v Werder Bremen 07/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Soren Storks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Michael Zetterer no chance!
90+7' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!

90+6' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Soren Storks stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Bayern Munich are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed to the left side of the goal, Michael Zetterer didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
90+2' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Raphael Guerreiro is replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich).
89' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
87' Patrick Kohlmann has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) replacing Marvin Ducksch.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Derrick Kohn leaves the pitch and Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) comes on.
84' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

82' 2 - 0 Goal! Konrad Laimer displays great vision and sends a pass to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
81' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Kingsley Coman is replaced by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
80' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) was too forceful with his tackle and Soren Storks interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Michael Zetterer.
76' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
73' Substitution. Sacha Boey walks off the pitch and Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
72' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
67' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Michael Zetterer.
67' Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:0.
63' Referee Soren Storks sees the trip by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
62' The referee shows the yellow card to Andre Silva (Werder Bremen).
61' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' What a huge chance for Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
59' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
56' 1 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Michael Zetterer into the bottom left corner.
56' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' A yellow card for bad language! Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
54' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
54' Handball by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen). Bayern Munich are given a penalty!
52' Patrick Kohlmann has decided to substitute Justin Njinmah and he is replaced by Andre Silva (Werder Bremen).
52' Soren Storks blows his whistle and it's Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Soren Storks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Problems for Patrick Kohlmann as Jens Stage is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) replaces him.
43' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer makes a comfortable save.
43' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
38' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
37' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 72:28.
34' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Soren Storks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
28' Unlucky! A great strike from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
27' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) launches a cross from the corner, but Michael Zetterer is alert to thwart the effort.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
23' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
22' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) plays a through ball but overhits it.
20' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

18' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Michael Zetterer blocks the shot with his legs.
14' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
14' Bayern Munich couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
13' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) makes a slide tackle, but referee Soren Storks blows for a foul.
10' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
8' It's a nice effort by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Michael Zetterer. Easy save.
6' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' The free kick finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
1' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
